module origen_019581 #(
    parameter BAUD_RATE = 9600,
    parameter BUF_LEN = 16
)(
    input wire clk_150m,
    input wire rst,
    input wire wvalid,
    input wire [7:0] char,
    input wire trans_st,
    output reg uart_txd,
    output reg busy,
    output reg overflow
);

    localparam CLK_FREQ = 150_000_000;
    localparam BR_ACC = CLK_FREQ / BAUD_RATE;

    reg [15:0] br_cnt;
    reg clk_br;
    reg [3:0] cnt_bit;
    reg [7:0] char_buf [BUF_LEN-1:0];
    reg [$clog2(BUF_LEN):0] num_char;
    reg [$clog2(BUF_LEN)-1:0] rd_ptr, wr_ptr;
    reg [7:0] tx_char;

    // Baud rate clock generation
    always @(posedge clk_150m or negedge rst) begin
        if (!rst) begin
            br_cnt <= 0;
            clk_br <= 0;
        end else if (br_cnt == BR_ACC - 1) begin
            br_cnt <= 0;
            clk_br <= ~clk_br;
        end else begin
            br_cnt <= br_cnt + 1;
        end
    end

    // Buffer management
    always @(posedge clk_150m or negedge rst) begin
        if (!rst) begin
            num_char <= 0;
            rd_ptr <= 0;
            wr_ptr <= 0;
            overflow <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (wvalid && !busy && num_char < BUF_LEN) begin
                char_buf[wr_ptr] <= char;
                wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 1;
                num_char <= num_char + 1;
            end
            if (trans_st && !busy && num_char > 0) begin
                busy <= 1;
                tx_char <= char_buf[rd_ptr];
                rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 1;
                num_char <= num_char - 1;
            end
            if (wvalid && num_char == BUF_LEN) begin
                overflow <= 1;
            end
            if (cnt_bit == 4'd9 && clk_br) begin
                if (num_char > 0) begin
                    tx_char <= char_buf[rd_ptr];
                    rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 1;
                    num_char <= num_char - 1;
                end else begin
                    busy <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // UART transmission
    always @(posedge clk_br or negedge rst) begin
        if (!rst) begin
            uart_txd <= 1;
            cnt_bit <= 0;
        end else if (busy) begin
            case (cnt_bit)
                4'd0: uart_txd <= 0;  // Start bit
                4'd1, 4'd2, 4'd3, 4'd4, 4'd5, 4'd6, 4'd7, 4'd8: uart_txd <= tx_char[cnt_bit-1];  // Data bits
                4'd9: uart_txd <= 1;  // Stop bit
                default: uart_txd <= 1;
            endcase
            if (cnt_bit == 4'd9) begin
                cnt_bit <= 0;
            end else begin
                cnt_bit <= cnt_bit + 1;
            end
        end else begin
            uart_txd <= 1;
            cnt_bit <= 0;
        end
    end

endmodule
